module: Exit/back handlers of the mission and pause screens. When a mission start/end screen is active, they send back to the "mission.control" route with the matching mode; otherwise to the gameplay route (ui_menuManager.getGameplayRoute(), "play" by default).

missionDetailsExitHandler.desc: Leaves the mission details: if a mission is active and a start/end screen is displayed, navigates to mission.control with {mode = screen mode}; otherwise to the gameplay route.

returns.desc: Result of navigate in the mission.control case; nil otherwise (navigation is started without returning its result).

pauseExitHandler.desc: Leaves the pause: navigates to mission.control {mode} if a mission start/end screen is active, otherwise to the gameplay route.

missionVehicleSelectorBackHandler.desc: Back from the mission vehicle selector: same logic as pauseExitHandler.
